kind: Integration traceability built from the frozen Inventory authority by reading all 67 rendered screens of the batch 4 revision. The design supplies no requirement identifiers and its own TRACEABILITY-v2.md is a control-type classification that does not match the screens; 67 unique screens are not evidence of coverage.

priorFindings.evidence: No screen shows a negative balance: Laundry Detergent is 2 EACH, the ledger's ADJ-2026-00030 row runs to 2, and 20/21 compute 2 - 5 = -3 and block. A Negative chip was added but it is inert and no screen shows its result (FR-INV-023 stays partial). The docs page still says negative stock appears 'as a historical/diagnostic status', which no screen shows.

The tile 'Counts In Progress or Review' = 2 equals CNT-2026-00015 (In Progress) + CNT-2026-00016 (Review) on screen 30. The subset is the design's choice; the frozen authority does not define the KPI.

30 and 37/46 now agree (+1 net, CNT-2026-00012). The store ledger (16) still shows CNT-2026-00012 as Teh Tarik Mix +5, not +1 (the manifest says it was changed), 43 still references ADJ-2026-00050 and -00051, 47 puts review at 16:10 and posting at 18:40 while the ledger row is dated 16:10, and 37/46 expected quantities (34 for Cream Crackers) do not match the 20 Sep position.
Batch ledger on 12 now ends with ADJ-2026-00041 +6 and B-2609-01 = 23, B-2609-02 = 11 (sum 34), consistent on 11, 13 and 36. But the batch detail header on 12 still says 20 EACH.
Not a design fix. Number inputs are hard-coded to step 1 and min 0 for every item.
Approve, cancel, opening stock and cost-visibility flows remain drawn; the manifest and TRACEABILITY-v2 label 22, 39 and 41 as unresolved gaps, which is accurate.
Screen 61 exists, labels thresholds as examples, states DEC-INV-007 is OPEN and that no reorder operation exists.

LOADING, EMPTY, CONFLICT, INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT, VALIDATION_ERROR and PERMISSION_DENIED now have screens (static). Qualifiers: 66 states a '> 0' rule that is not in the frozen FRS; 67 names an 'Inventory Manager' role that is not a frozen persona; 63's action is not wired; 64 has no refresh action.
3-in-1 White Coffee is still available and Low Stock while its only batch is expired (DEC-INV-005 OPEN).

Better than claimed: an h1 exists on 66 of 67 screens (05 has none); ARIA role=table with named tables on 02, 03, 04, 06, 07, 13, 14, 16, 17 and 49; labelled number, select and textarea controls on 18, 19, 33, 34, 35, 50 and 66; live regions on 18, 19, 20, 62, 64, 65, 66, 67; no unlabelled control or nameless button. Still open: no literal table, caption or th anywhere; header-like grids without table roles on 09, 10, 11, 12, 30, 33-38, 44, 46, 50 and 61; no dialog semantics, focus movement or focus return for the movement and batch drawers; no inputs on 27, 31, 36 or the approval note on 22; the count list scroll region (30) is a focusable unnamed div; controls are inert (18 ignores typed values, 33 does not feed review). The manifest's claim that 09 and 11 were converted is false.

Identical to the first export: 02, 03, 04, 06, 07, 16, 30, 49 clip or scroll horizontally at 1280x720, 1366x768 and 1368x800, and 30 at 1920x1080. No action button is clipped or off-viewport at any of the four sizes (only the table rows exceed the width), but the MOVING WAC and LAST MOVEMENT columns are cut off.

Computed on 3,351 rendered text elements: every earlier pair now passes 4.5:1 (sidebar notes, placeholder, headings, meta text, Restricted). One pair still fails: 'New Stock Count' white on #f0f0f0 (1.14:1) on 02, 03, 04, 06 and 49. The claimed fix does not work because newCountBg is defined but never returned from renderVals, so the style hole stays empty.

Grouped pages now match the registry. The print variants were left unchanged and their page headers still carry the shortened titles for 08, 09, 11, 25, 26 and 60 (19 header mismatches across five variants).
The index now shows a plain, non-clickable label for the Back Office reference; 53 local references resolve and none is dangling.
The revision manifest places documentation on screens 52-60, but it is cumulative and internally inconsistent (see N10).
No 'approved Back Office' wording remains; the index and docs say review-ready (not approved) and name the five approved packages.

No requirement identifier appears on any screen. TRACEABILITY-v2.md covers 67 screens but classifies by control type, not by requirement, and 13 of its single-screen rows carry a title that is not the screen's registry title (see N1).

newFindings.title: TRACEABILITY-v2.md rows do not match the screens
newFindings.detail: 13 single-screen rows describe a different screen from the registry: 05 'empty state' (actual: Store Node unavailable), 06 'read-only role' (Cloud Sync unavailable), 07 'offline/local scope' (read-only / permission-limited), 15, 36, 39, 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45 and 48. Claims for 09 and 11 (keyboard-activatable rows, ARIA table) are false: only 02, 03, 04, 06, 07, 16 and 49 have tabbable rows and 11 has no table role. The file says it was not checked against FR-INV; it is not usable as coverage evidence.

newFindings.title: The 'New Stock Count' fix is ineffective
newFindings.detail: newCountBg is defined on one line and used on another but is not in the values returned by renderVals; the button background is still missing (computed #f0f0f0, white text, 1.14:1).

newFindings.title: Batch detail disagrees with its own table and ledger
newFindings.detail: Screen 12's header shows Quantity 20 EACH for B-2609-01; the batch table, near-expiry list and the same screen's ledger (ending 23) show 23.

newFindings.title: Count variance chain still inconsistent (F3 remainder)
newFindings.detail: See F3 in the prior findings.

newFindings.title: Row keyboard handlers do not isolate nested controls
newFindings.detail: Driven in a browser: Enter and Space on a focused row open it (Space does not scroll), other keys are ignored, and a nested input keeps its own typing. But a nested button's Enter or Space still fires its own click and then the row's unguarded onClick opens the row; a mouse click behaves the same. The e.target check only guards the keydown path. No shipped row contains a nested control today.

newFindings.title: Drawers have no dialog behaviour
newFindings.detail: After Enter on a movement row the drawer opens but focus stays on the row, there is no role=dialog or aria-modal, the next Tab moves to the next row behind the drawer, and Escape does not close it.

newFindings.title: Controls are inert
newFindings.detail: Typing 7 into the adjustment quantity or pressing Decrease leaves the preview at 43 and Continue goes to a canned 'Requested decrease 5'; the Negative, Zero Stock and Low Stock chips on 02 do not filter ('10 of 10 items'); entered counts do not reach review; 66 shows the error whatever is typed. TRACEABILITY-v2 discloses the first and third; the filter chips are not disclosed.

newFindings.title: Remaining accessibility structure gaps
newFindings.detail: Screen 05 has no h1; no literal table markup anywhere; inputs missing on 27, 31, 36 and the approval note on 22; the count list (30) rows are not activatable and its scroll region is an unnamed focusable div.

newFindings.title: Print variants keep the old titles
newFindings.detail: 08, 09, 11, 25, 26, 60 print headers differ from the source registry. The New States headers add '- New in revision', a label rather than a title.

newFindings.title: The revision manifest is cumulative and self-contradictory
newFindings.detail: It says TOTAL PACKAGED FILES 15 + manifest = 16, then 17 + manifest = 18, still says 65 screens and 'print variants unchanged' in older sections, lists superseded hashes for the source, and does not hash TRACEABILITY-v2.md. Actual archive: 18 files = 16 payload (14 .dc.html + support.js + doc-page.js) + TRACEABILITY-v2.md + the manifest; the final declared hash of every payload file matches.

newFindings.title: New state screens carry non-frozen wording
newFindings.detail: 67 tells the user to ask 'an Inventory Manager or Admin' (frozen personas are Storekeeper, Manager, Admin, Audit; no permission code is named); 66 states a quantity must be greater than 0 (FR-INV-081 only requires an explicit direction and quantity; FR-INV-007 requires precision rules); the quantity inputs are fixed at step 1.

newFindings.title: Stale documentation text
newFindings.detail: The Design System & Docs page still says negative stock appears 'as a historical/diagnostic status' although no screen shows a negative balance now.
